summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of the new inline document viewer feature for iWhistle Partnership Documents. All 17 specified features tested successfully with 100% pass rate. The document viewer provides excellent user experience with slide-in panel, sticky header navigation, TOC scrolling, responsive design, and PDF generation capabilities.
passed_tests: Documents section shows 4 cards (Pilot Program Agreement, Data Processing Agreements, Terms of Service, Privacy Policy) with both View and Download buttons
Clicking View on Pilot Program Agreement opens document viewer with full content (12 sections)
Clicking View on Data Processing Agreements opens document viewer with DPA/GDPR/CCPA content (9 sections)
Clicking View on Terms of Service opens document viewer with full TOS content (12 sections)
Clicking View on Privacy Policy opens document viewer with full privacy policy content (11 sections)
Document viewer has sticky header with document title, version (2.1, 1.4, 3.0, 2.3), and last updated dates
Document viewer has Print and PDF download buttons in header - all functional
Document viewer has close (X) button that properly closes the viewer
Document viewer has scrollable Table of Contents pills in header (12, 9, 12, 11 TOC items respectively)
Clicking TOC pills scrolls to corresponding sections with smooth navigation
Document content is well-formatted with section headings (h2), subsections with blue left border styling, and readable text
Document viewer has back-to-top button that appears when scrolled down and functions correctly
Download button on cards generates PDF without opening viewer - tested for all 4 documents
PDF download from viewer header generates proper PDF files with document content
Closing viewer returns to documents section normally
Document viewer has backdrop blur overlay that closes when clicked
All 4 documents have multiple sections with rich legal content including GDPR, CCPA, encryption, privacy terms
Responsive design works correctly on desktop (1920px), tablet (768px), and mobile (390px) viewports
TOC container has horizontal scroll behavior on smaller screens
Document sections properly structured with data-section-id attributes for navigation
Version and last updated information displays correctly in viewer header
Print functionality available with print-specific CSS styles applied
Subsections formatted with proper blue left border (rgba(77, 184, 232, 0.3))
Document footer displays copyright and version information
Keyboard navigation supports Enter to open and focus management
Rapid open/close operations handled smoothly
Content validation confirmed rich legal terminology present
